name: Desert Jewel
description: The Desert Jewel was a luxury yacht owned by Fayet Kelen, the owner of Kelen Biolabs. It was mainly used by his daughter, Nakari Kelen, for scouting planets for her father. For that purpose it was loaded with supplies and survival gear and held a lot of additional technology like big sublight engines, jammers, sensor arrays and shield generators. This power was completely invisible from the front or the sides, making the ship ideal for speed, spying and surviving and escaping firefights while looking slow, weak and innocent.
